PURPOSE OF THE PROJECT

jobs.job_title: Data Analyst Remote | Full Time  Or Part Time | No Experience Required
jobs.job_description:
Job Description

We are looking to hire a data analyst to join our data team. You will take responsibility for managing our master data set, developing reports, and troubleshooting data issues. To do well in this role you need a very fine eye for detail, experience as a data analyst, and a deep understanding of the popular data analysis tools and databases.

DATA ANAYLYST RESPONSIBILITIES:

Managing master data, including creation, updates, and deletion.

Managing users and user roles.

Provide quality assurance of imported data, working with quality assurance analysts if necessary.

Commissioning and decommissioning of data sets.

Processing confidential data and information according to guidelines.

Helping develop reports and analyses.

Managing and designing the reporting environment, including data sources, security, and metadata.

Supporting initiatives for data integrity and normalization.

Assessing tests and implementing new or upgraded software and assisting with strategic decisions on new systems.

Generating reports from single or multiple systems.

Troubleshooting the reporting database environment and reports.

Evaluating changes and updates to source production systems.

DATA ANAYLYST REQUIREMENTS:

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college in computer science.

Work experience as a data analyst or in a related field.

Ability to work with stakeholders to assess potential risks.

Ability to analyze existing tools and databases and provide software solution recommendations.

Ability to translate business requirements into nontechnical, lay terms.

High-level experience in methodologies and processes for managing large-scale databases.

High-level written and verbal communication skills.

Apply for this Data Analyst Remote | Full Time Or Part Time | No Experience Required position

Role purpose

Own or support the business-facing data workstream for ServiceNow GRC/IRM and SPM implementation. The role profiles source data, defines mappings and quality rules, coordinates cleansing decisions, validates transformed and loaded data, and provides auditable reconciliation evidence. Technical extraction, transformation, or loading development is performed only when explicitly assigned.

Key responsibilities

• Inventory source systems, files, owners, entities, fields, reference data, attachments, history, volumes, formats, and known quality issues.

• Profile source data and quantify completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, referential integrity, duplication, and timeliness issues.

• Develop and maintain source-to-target mapping specifications, data dictionaries, transformation rules, lookup mappings, defaulting rules, and ownership records.

• Define clear data cleansing, standardization, de-duplication, enrichment, archival, rejection, exception, and remediation rules with business owners.

• Coordinate mapping workshops for policy, authority document, control, risk, audit, finding, BCM, portfolio, demand, project, resource, financial, and related data as applicable.

• Prepare validation queries, sampling approaches, control totals, reconciliation reports, exception logs, and migration sign-off evidence.

• Validate mock loads and migration cycles; document defects and support root-cause analysis, correction, retesting, and readiness decisions.

• Support attachment and historical-data assessment, privacy/security classification, retention requirements, and access constraints.

• Collaborate with ServiceNow consultants, data engineers, integration teams, and business owners while maintaining clear accountability for source correction and target validation.

• Develop the end user training material and conduct end user training sessions before or after going live.

• Provide demonstrations, knowledge transfer, administrator guidance, and functional handover documentation.

• Maintain mapping version control, lineage, decisions, assumptions, risks, and change impacts.

Mandatory experience and knowledge

• At least 5 years of data analysis, data quality, migration, master/reference data, or data-management experience, including at least 2 years supporting ServiceNow implementations.

• Previous ServiceNow data mapping or migration experience in at least one proposal-scope domain: Policy, Compliance, Risk, Audit, BCM, SPM, Demand, Portfolio, Project, or a closely related capability.

• Strong hands-on capability in source-to-target mapping, data profiling, cleansing-rule definition, validation, reconciliation, and exception management.

• Proficiency in SQL and advanced spreadsheet analysis; ability to work with CSV, JSON, APIs, relational data, and large structured extracts.

• Understanding of ServiceNow tables, reference fields, choice/lookup data, import sets, transform concepts, sys_ids, coalesce logic, and data-load dependencies.

• Ability to produce clear mapping specifications, data-quality reports, issue logs, and migration sign-off evidence.

Preferred experience

• Experience with ServiceNow import sets, transform maps, IntegrationHub, or ETL tools, while recognizing that development may sit with a separate technical team.

• Experience with high-volume historical records, attachments, multilingual data, regulatory content, or complex reference-data mappings.

• Knowledge of data governance, metadata, lineage, privacy, retention, and data-quality controls.

• Experience using Power Query, Python, data-quality tools, BI tools, or reconciliation automation.

• Arabic language proficiency (spoken and written) is strongly preferred; professional English is required.

Academic and professional certifications

• Required: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.

• Required: Recognized data qualification or certification appropriate to the role, such as DAMA CDMP, DCAM, Microsoft data certification, Informatica certification, or equivalent.

• Strongly preferred: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).

• Preferred: ServiceNow implementation certification or training relevant to GRC/IRM, SPM, IntegrationHub, or platform data management.

• Preferred: SQL, data-quality, ETL, BI, or cloud-data certification supported by practical experience.

Core competencies

• Data profiling and quality analysis

• Source-to-target mapping

• Cleansing and validation rule design

• SQL and reconciliation

• Metadata, lineage, and documentation

• Cross-team issue resolution

Data Analyst vacancy in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an experienced analyst to join our team on-site. You will collect, analyze, and interpret data from diverse sources and present it in a way that supports business decisions.

The role emphasizes analytical thinking, reporting, and clear communication. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a preference for SQL, R, or Python knowledge, though these are not strictly required.

We are looking for a Performance Analytics & Insights Senior Specialist to turn marketing and business data into actionable insights that support better decision-making and improve overall performance.

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze customer acquisition, retention, engagement, and loyalty metrics.
• Track marketing KPIs and measure performance against targets.
• Measure campaign effectiveness, ROI, ROAS, CAC, CLTV, and conversion rates.
• Prepare regular performance reports highlighting key insights, trends, risks, and opportunities.
• Identify performance trends and opportunities through data analysis.
• Provide data-driven recommendations to optimize marketing campaigns and investments.
• Collaborate with Marketing, Digital, CRM, Finance, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
• Support data-driven decision-making through clear and effective data visualization.
• Contribute to forecasting, predictive analytics, and continuous performance improvement.

Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Statistics, Data Analytics, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field.
• 5–7 years of relevant experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Performance Marketing, or Data Analytics.
• Strong proficiency in Power BI and Advanced Excel.
• Experience in dashboard development, data visualization, and performance reporting.
• Strong understanding of digital marketing metrics and campaign performance.
• Experience measuring marketing ROI and campaign effectiveness.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with SQL, Google BigQuery, GA4, or Adobe Analytics.
• Google Analytics or Marketing Analytics certification.
• Experience in Retail, FMCG, Hospitality, Entertainment, Shopping Malls, or other customer-focused industries.

Key Skills

Marketing Analytics | Business Intelligence | Power BI | Advanced Excel | Dashboard Development | Data Visualization | KPI Management | Campaign Performance Analysis | Data Storytelling | Strategic Insights
